body:
## Pull request overview

Implements Phase 13–14 L1 foundation work by extending the Kanban schema/runtime for quick-add, cover images, and conditional formatting, and adding new Forms & Data Collection surfaces (EmbeddableForm + FormAnalytics) alongside a drag-and-drop FileField update. Also updates shared types/Zod schemas and marks the roadmap phases as complete.

**Changes:**
- Extend `ObjectKanbanSchema` (TypeScript + Zod) with `quickAdd`, `coverImageField`, `allowCollapse`, and `conditionalFormatting`.
- Add Kanban runtime support for quick-add UI, cover images on cards, and conditional formatting styles across both implementations.
- Add `EmbeddableForm` + `FormAnalytics` components and register them in the form plugin; enhance `FileField` with drag-and-drop UX.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 20 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts | Adds Zod validation for new Kanban schema props including conditional formatting rules. |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Extends `ObjectKanbanSchema` and introduces `KanbanConditionalFormattingRule` type. |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Re-exports `KanbanConditionalFormattingRule` from the types package. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/types.ts | Updates plugin Kanban schema surface to include new Kanban props (quick add, cover image field, conditional formatting). |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx | Maps schema to Kanban implementations, including cover image mapping and forwarding new props. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx | Implements quick add UI, card cover image rendering, and conditional formatting styles (non-enhanced Kanban). |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanEnhanced.tsx | Implements quick add UI, card cover image rendering, and conditional formatting styles in enhanced/virtualized Kanban. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx | Exports/registers new form components (`embeddable-form`, `form-analytics`) in the ComponentRegistry. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/FormAnalytics.tsx | New analytics dashboard component for submissions metrics visualization. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/EmbeddableForm.tsx | New public/standalone embeddable form component with branding, prefill, thank-you/redirect behavior. |
| packages/fields/src/widgets/FileField.tsx | Enhances FileField with drag-and-drop zone, drag-over feedback, and basic thumbnail/icon rendering. |
| ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md | Updates roadmap status/version to reflect Phase 13–14 L1 completion. |
</details>



<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1)</summary>

**packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx:35**
* `ObjectForm` requires a `dataSource` for non-inline submissions, but this registry renderer does not inject one from `SchemaRendererProvider` (via `useSchemaContext`). When used via schema rendering, create/edit submissions will throw. Update the renderer to pass through `dataSource` from context.
```
// Register object-form component
const ObjectFormRenderer: React.FC<{ schema: any }> = ({ schema }) => {
  return <ObjectForm schema={schema} />;
};
```
</details>

`ObjectForm` already performs `dataSource.create/update` and then calls `schema.onSuccess` with the *result*. This EmbeddableForm `handleSubmit` calls `dataSource.create` again, which will duplicate records and also treats the result object as form input. Refactor so this callback only handles post-submit UI state (submitted/redirect) and does not create the record here.

`ObjectForm` requires a `dataSource` for non-inline submissions, but the EmbeddableForm registry renderer does not inject one from `SchemaRendererProvider`. When used via schema rendering, submissions will throw "DataSource is required...". Use `useSchemaContext()` in the renderer and pass `dataSource` through to `<EmbeddableForm ... />` (and similarly for `ObjectFormRenderer`).

Imports are declared mid-module here (after other statements) and the same module is also re-exported above, which is redundant and commonly violates import-order lint rules. Move the EmbeddableForm import to the top with other imports and reuse it for both the export and the renderer.

The JSDoc says `backgroundColor`/`borderColor` can be a Tailwind class or CSS color, but the Kanban implementations apply these via inline `style` (CSS color values). Either change the type/docs to explicitly require CSS color strings, or update the implementation to support Tailwind class names (e.g., separate `backgroundClassName`/`borderClassName`).
```suggestion
  /**
   * Background color to apply as a CSS color string.
   * Examples: '#ff0000', 'rgb(255, 0, 0)', 'red'.
   * Note: Tailwind class names are not supported here.
   */
  backgroundColor?: string;
  /**
   * Border color to apply as a CSS color string.
   * Examples: '#ff0000', 'rgb(255, 0, 0)', 'red'.
   * Note: Tailwind class names are not supported here.
   */
```

`ConditionalFormattingRule` is redefined locally, but the canonical `KanbanConditionalFormattingRule` is now exported from `@object-ui/types`. Reusing the shared type will prevent drift between protocol types (zod/objectql) and the runtime implementation.

New Quick Add UI is introduced here, but the plugin-kanban test suite currently has no coverage for it (no `quickAdd` assertions found). Add RTL tests to verify: button toggles input, Enter submits, Escape cancels, and callback receives (columnId, title).

KanbanEnhanced duplicates the conditional formatting rule type even though `KanbanConditionalFormattingRule` is now exported from `@object-ui/types`. Prefer importing and using the shared type to keep plugin and protocol definitions aligned.

`conditionalFormatting` is defined as an inline object type here. Since `KanbanConditionalFormattingRule` is now exported from `@object-ui/types`, reuse it to avoid type drift between the plugin schema and the shared protocol types.

The renderer schema types `conditionalFormatting` inline, duplicating the shared `KanbanConditionalFormattingRule` now exported from `@object-ui/types`. Prefer importing and using the shared type here so schema/type definitions stay consistent across packages.

The embeddable-form renderer does not inject `dataSource` from `useSchemaContext()`. As implemented, embeddable forms rendered via schema will not be able to submit (ObjectForm throws when `dataSource` is missing). Pass `dataSource` through to `<EmbeddableForm ... />`.

Same issue as above: avoid introducing a second mid-module import for FormAnalytics when it is already re-exported. Keep imports at the top and reuse them for renderers/exports to reduce redundancy and keep linting consistent.

`coverImageField` is passed through the KanbanBoard/KanbanBoardInner props but is never read. Since cover images are already mapped onto `card.coverImage` upstream, this prop is dead API surface and should be removed (or actually used) to avoid confusion.

Conditional formatting logic is added via `getCardStyles`, but there are no tests asserting that matching rules apply the expected background/border styling (and non-matching rules do not). Add tests for operators (`equals`, `contains`, `in`, etc.) to prevent regressions.

EmbeddableForm is a new public-facing submission surface, but there are currently no tests covering its behavior. Add plugin-form tests to verify rendering, successful submit flow (including thank-you state), and error handling/redirect behavior.

This widget generates preview URLs via `URL.createObjectURL` (in `processFiles` above), but those object URLs are never revoked. With drag-and-drop/multi-file usage this can leak memory over time. Add cleanup to revoke object URLs when files are removed and when the component unmounts (without revoking persisted upload URLs).

`onBlur={handleSubmit}` combined with the Escape key handler can cause an unintended submit: pressing Escape sets `isAdding` false (input unmounts/blur) but React state updates may not have cleared `title` before the blur handler runs. Consider removing blur-to-submit or adding a cancel/ref guard so Escape reliably cancels without submitting.

Quick Add is implemented here, but there is no test coverage for the new UX (toggle input, Enter/Escape behavior, callback invocation). Add tests to KanbanEnhanced.test.tsx to cover this path (both virtualized and non-virtualized if applicable).

Same Quick Add issue here: `onBlur={handleSubmit}` can fire after Escape-triggered state updates, potentially submitting the previous title even though the user canceled. Add a cancel guard or avoid blur-to-submit so Escape consistently cancels without creating a card.
